artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan to build a generic typescript extension in the source store, with an embedded design specification covering all eight required outcomes (file manifest, context tree, both agents, hard_contracts, keyword_overrides collision check, rules glob, verification-hook contract, typescript-web.md line split).

memory_candidates.content: When planning a new extension for this agent-system source store, the research report's file manifest is not sufficient on its own: three structural obligations are easy to miss and each is enforced by a different lint. (1) Every language extension ships a skills/skill-{domain}-{research,implementation}/SKILL.md pair and declares both in provides.skills -- rust, python, nix, web and latex all do. (2) provides.scripts takes a BARE BASENAME while the top-level hooks map takes the scripts/-prefixed path; nix/manifest.json is the live two-form example, and a mismatch means the hook silently never deploys. (3) agent-system/extensions/README.md's '## Available Extensions' table needs a row for the new directory or lint-extension-readme-table.sh FAILs on a bidirectional diff naming the directory. Verify all three against a precedent manifest before sizing phases.
